messages.author: priya
messages.text: hall stays shut until an engineer has been, nobody under that rail for any reason

messages.author: stan
messages.text: a delivery van has mounted the kerb outside and hit the hall gatepost, the post is down

messages.author: priya
messages.text: I have the spare torches, handing them out at the door

messages.author: mabel
messages.text: I heard the bang from the foyer, the van is across the pavement at an angle

messages.author: odette
messages.text: someone is slumped in the van, call an ambulance, and keep the children inside away from the gate

messages.author: hugo
messages.text: gate area is cordoned with chairs, nobody is going out that way

messages.author: clive
messages.text: ambulance is on its way, I am staying with the driver and talking to him, he is responding

messages.author: stan
messages.text: thursday list: stack the folding chairs after lunch club, check the urn, lock the store

messages.author: odette
messages.text: the clock in the main room is five minutes fast, as ever

messages.author: yusuf
messages.text: chairs are mine, the legs are all wobbly on the blue ones

messages.author: greta
messages.text: urn descaled last week, just fill and switch on for the evening class

messages.author: stan
messages.text: and the costume trunks go back up to the loft before the dancers arrive

messages.author: greta
messages.text: tea urn has tipped in the kitchen and there is water everywhere in there

messages.author: greta
messages.text: blankets from the store cupboard are coming out with me

messages.author: greta
messages.text: it was not just the urn, the pipe behind it has split and it is jetting at the wall

messages.author: hugo
messages.text: it is into the electrics cupboard now, sparks from the top box

messages.author: clive
messages.text: everyone out of the kitchen wing, get the whole hall to the green, this is an evacuation now

messages.author: stan
messages.text: wing is empty, I have the class lists, counting on the green as they arrive

messages.author: priya
messages.text: breaker is off, water is slowing, but nobody goes back in until the electrician says so

messages.author: greta
messages.text: the ticket site crashed at opening again, same crash as the panto rush

messages.author: greta
messages.text: the clock in the main room is five minutes fast, as ever

messages.author: priya
messages.text: and stall bookings flooded the phone line all morning in reply

messages.author: greta
messages.text: a flood of calls and a crashed website, a very modern morning. paper list at the desk still works

messages.author: priya
messages.text: it does. meanwhile the hall run of the play has two more weeks, good run for us

messages.author: mabel
messages.text: cistern level log: three quarters at monday, seven eighths yesterday, full to the lip this morning

messages.author: greta
messages.text: from me just this: I am by the main doors and I will stay put

messages.author: mabel
messages.text: siphon took off what it could, level is back a finger's width and no more

messages.author: clive
messages.text: so the inflow has picked up beyond the siphon some time this week

messages.author: mabel
messages.text: that is the shape of it. if it lips over again we need the contractor's pump, booked not begged

messages.author: clive
messages.text: ring them friday and book it, numbers are in the log if they argue

messages.author: stan
messages.text: there is a fizzing sound from the hall battery cabinet, like a kettle element

messages.author: priya
messages.text: I have the spare torches, handing them out at the door

messages.author: stan
messages.text: it is louder and the cabinet door is hot now, something in there is cooking

messages.author: greta
messages.text: hot battery cabinet is serious, out of that room and pull the door to behind you

messages.author: mabel
messages.text: it has gone bang and there is smoke rolling along the corridor ceiling

messages.author: odette
messages.text: everyone out of the building, evacuate to the green, do not use the corridor past the smoke

messages.author: hugo
messages.text: green is filling, register is with me, doors are being held for the last classes

messages.author: priya
messages.text: appliances are turning in at the gate, keep the green count going and the lane clear

messages.author: mabel
messages.text: hugo cut his palm on the stage door latch, it is bleeding a fair bit but he is calm and sitting

messages.author: greta
messages.text: from me just this: I am by the main doors and I will stay put

messages.author: priya
messages.text: first aid box is under the office counter, bring the big plasters

messages.author: mabel
messages.text: pressure on it now with a clean pad, it is slowing already

messages.author: clive
messages.text: I will sit with him and check it in ten minutes, stitches unlikely by the look of it

messages.author: yusuf
messages.text: there is a scorch smell coming from the props cupboard, sweet and electrical

messages.author: odette
messages.text: from me just this: I am by the main doors and I will stay put

messages.author: greta
messages.text: that cupboard holds the stage light spares, has anything been plugged in today

messages.author: yusuf
messages.text: nothing today. the door of it feels warm at the top edge though

messages.author: greta
messages.text: leave it closed, I am coming with the caretaker and his keys to open it carefully

messages.author: clive
messages.text: smoke rolling out of the library store vents, thick grey, and a glow behind the louvres

messages.author: hugo
messages.text: keeping the path to the green clear, chairs moved aside

messages.author: priya
messages.text: I see the glow too, that room is alight, not just smouldering

messages.author: stan
messages.text: everyone out of the library wing, out through the foyer, assemble at the flag bed

messages.author: yusuf
messages.text: reading room is empty, I swept it, doors are shut behind me

messages.author: mabel
messages.text: second appliance is coming, keep the yard clear and the count going at assembly

messages.author: priya
messages.text: puddle spreading under the hall kitchen sink, it has reached the doorway already

messages.author: clive
messages.text: I will listen on this channel and keep it clear for the others

messages.author: odette
messages.text: is the tap off, or is it still coming

messages.author: priya
messages.text: taps are off and it is still spreading slowly, so it is a pipe underneath

messages.author: odette
messages.text: mop bucket for now, take a photo of the waterline, plumber gets a call in the morning

messages.author: yusuf
messages.text: the brook has come over the bank behind the hall, the whole garden is under water

messages.author: priya
messages.text: keeping the path to the green clear, chairs moved aside

messages.author: clive
messages.text: it is through the back door and across the kitchen floor already

messages.author: mabel
messages.text: everyone in, move everything off the floor and get the electrics isolated, now

messages.author: odette
messages.text: chairs are up, urn is safe on the counter, water still coming in at the door

messages.author: priya
messages.text: the lane is a river, cars stay where they are, keep people inside on the dry side
